tips.infinite_session: Use an infinite-time session when you are not sure how long you want to keep focus.
tips.sweet_spot: Sessions of 30–60 minutes give the best apple yield for your time — that's the harvest sweet spot.
tips.accelerate_timing: Activate an Accelerate Card right before your longest focus day — it doubles your apple harvest for a full 24 hours.
tips.focus_rating: Your focus rating on the session summary scales your apple harvest — keep your phone still while focusing to earn a better suggested rating.
tips.goal_badge: Conclude a focus goal to mint a badge that captures your performance — total time, sessions, and streaks.
tips.widget_setup: Add a Bittersweet widget to your home screen to keep your progress in sight and start focusing faster.
tips.recurring_todos: Make a TODO recurring and it will come back on schedule — perfect for habits you focus on daily.
tips.unlock_cost: Unlocking blocked apps costs apples for every minute — keep unlocks short to protect your harvest.
tips.swipe_to_start: Swipe a TODO, a tag, or a goal to the left and let go — a session starts right away, already set to the right tag and duration.
tips.multi_task_mode: Turn on Multi-Task Mode in Preferences to add a second tag to a session, so time spent on two things at once counts for both. (Premium)
tips.apple_health: Connect Apple Health in Settings and finished workouts import themselves as focus sessions — including ones logged by apps like SmartGym and Peloton. (Premium)
tips.inner_circle: Pick up to 3 Grove friends as your Inner Circle in Settings → Grove — if you go quiet for too long, they get a gentle nudge to check in on you.
tips.goal_reminders: Switch on Goal Reminders in Preferences and choose the time — you only get nudged on days you're actually behind pace.
tips.rating_activity_type: Give each tag an activity type so motion knows what focus looks like for it — then tap “Why this rating?” on a session to see how yours was worked out.
tips.contact_support: Something broken, or an idea for us? Settings → Support & About has Help & Feedback to chat with us, and Feature Requests to suggest and vote on ideas.

ratingInsights.title: How we estimated this
ratingInsights.noMotionData: No motion data was available for this session.

ratingInsights.disclaimerSelfRatedMotionOff: To have movement rate your sessions, switch this tag to Stationary or Active and turn on motion access in Settings.
ratingInsights.disclaimerTurnOnMotion: Turn motion access on in Settings to have future sessions rated from your movement.
ratingInsights.disclaimerActivityMismatch: If this tag's activity type doesn't match what you actually did, change it for more accurate ratings.
